script.title: Pelican Fish Courier
script.description: A white pelican in a courier cap pedals a seaside delivery bicycle along the boardwalk, wingtips gripping the handlebars, scarf streaming, a fish in its bill and crates of the day's catch front and back, bound for the little fish kiosk.
